newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary shares seen steady to higher on Dow, dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary shares seen steady to higher on Dow, dlr.

text.p: Hungarian shares were expected to extend Wednesday's gains, propelled by the Dow Jones' overnight rise and a strong dollar, amid some profit-taking in shares that rallied yesterday.
"The U.S. market is strong, the Russian market is also strong and except for some profit-taking I expect a strong market (in Hungary)," said Balazs Bathory of Creditanstalt Securities.
He added that Wednesday's gainers such as hotelier Danubius and OTP Bank were susceptible to profit-taking.
On Wednesday OTP finished at 5,150 forints, up 200, while Danubius put on 145 forints to end at 5,650.
Another trader said she expected the Hungarian market to be driven by outside factors in the absence of fresh domestic news.
"There is no important (domestic) news, but the Dow rose and the dollar is strong," said Andrea Keresztesi of ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett.
She added that she also expected turnover to pick up on Thursday.
"There were some agency crosses on Wednesday, but today I expect real trade to increase," she said.
On Wednesday the BUX index finished at a new closing high of 6,870.57 points, up 116.62.
